# ICLE (Institute of Continuing Legal Education)

> ICLE provides continuing legal education, professional development, and practice resources for Michigan lawyers and legal professionals.

ICLE is a leading provider of continuing legal education for Michigan's legal community, offering seminars, educational resources, and professional partnerships. The organization serves legal professionals across Michigan with tools, networking opportunities, and expert-led educational programs.

## Key Topics

- Continuing Legal Education
- Michigan Law
- Legal Seminars
- Professional Development
- Practice Areas
- Legal Professionals
- Contributor Directory
- Partnership Subscription
- CNA Professional Liability
- Legal Networking
- Expert Speakers
- Michigan Estate Planning
- Customer Support
- Account Management
